claim: Form native requests from admitted current owned needs and owned content; do not select a route, pay work, claim fulfillment or close FT4.1.
rules: Oldest pending current demand by first_seen then exact actor/reference; one request per explicit call with deterministic request identity.
Revalidate current paid need revision, endorsement, actor and exact payload against current actor view. Suspended, stale, unpaid or foreign demands cannot form requests.
Canonical requests preserve actor/context/cue/target/demand and use existing SelectionRequest; optional means remain absent at this boundary. No route or recipe is an input.

Workflow requests include all latest unretracted owned c7w.data bindings with exact context/cue/target, sorted by reference; bounded native interface accepts 1..8. Zero content defers; >8 defers visibly without choosing an evaluator-preferred subset. No free public uptake.
Requests do not mutate native state or the admission ledger. Missing optional support stays explicit and is integrated in b2/FT4.2.

Independent auditor reconstructs exact request from saved participant view bytes, without importing request generator, executor, selector or scheduler. Native input provenance remains checked by admission auditor.
Fulfillment, requests generated from pressure signals and controller integration remain b2; every parent FT4 gate remains unchanged.
panel: canonical and workflow current owned demand
oldest obligation wins independent of insertion order
hidden material changes do not change request
new paid content changes workflow request
zero and nine accessible workflow inputs defer visibly
no mutation or payment; exact request restart
gate: All eight exact method IDs pass, both request witnesses reconstructed, unchanged frozen source. This is b1 acceptance only.
